Ability Score Improvement: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Cannot increase above 20.
Action Surge (on use): Take one additional action on your turn. Can be used once per short rest.
Action Surge (two uses): Take two additional actions on your turn. Can be used twice per short rest.
Arcane Recovery: Recover spell slots during a short rest. Choose slots up to half your wizard level (rounded down).
Archdruid: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action and ignore Druid Circle requirements.
Aura improvements: Your auras extend further and provide greater benefits to nearby allies.
Aura of Courage: Allies within 30 feet cannot be frightened while you are conscious.
Aura of Protection: Allies within 30 feet gain bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier.
Bard College: Choose a College of Lore or College of Valor for specialized bard abilities.
Bard College Feature: Your Bard College grants additional features based on your college.
Bardic Inspiration (d10): You can inspire allies with your music or oratory, granting extra dice for ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws.
Bardic Inspiration (d12): Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d12.
Bardic Inspiration (d6): You can inspire allies with your music or oratory, granting extra dice for ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws.
Bardic Inspiration (d8): Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d8.
Beast Spells: You can cast spells while in Wild Shape form.
Blindsense: As long as you aren't blinded or deafened, you can pinpoint the location of hidden creatures within 10 feet.
Brutal Critical (1 die): When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, you roll an extra weapon damage die.
Brutal Critical (2 dice): When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, you roll two extra weapon damage dice.
Brutal Critical (3 dice): When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, you roll three extra weapon damage dice.
Channel Divinity (1/rest): You can channel divine energy once per short rest. Effects vary by domain.
Channel Divinity (2/rest): You can channel divine energy twice per short rest.
Channel Divinity (3/rest): You can channel divine energy three times per short rest.
Cleansing Touch: You can end one disease or condition on yourself as an action.
Countercharm: As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. Allies gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.
Cunning Action: You can take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Danger Sense: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against traps and you can't be blinded when computing your AC.
Deflect Missiles: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, you can deflect it and catch it. Must be proficient with a shield.
Destroy Undead (CR 1): Any undead of CR 1 or lower that fails a saving throw is destroyed if you hit it with a turning attack.
Destroy Undead (CR 1/2): Any undead of CR 1/2 or lower that fails a saving throw is destroyed if you hit it with a turning attack.
Destroy Undead (CR 2): Any undead of CR 2 or lower that fails a saving throw is destroyed if you hit it with a turning attack.
Destroy Undead (CR 3): Any undead of CR 3 or lower that fails a saving throw is destroyed if you hit it with a turning attack.
Destroy Undead (CR 4): Any undead of CR 4 or lower that fails a saving throw is destroyed if you hit it with a turning attack.
Diamond Soul: You automatically succeed on saving throws against spells and effects that target other creatures.
Divine Domain Feature: Your Divine Domain grants additional features based on your domain.
Divine Health: You have immunity to disease and poison.
Divine Intervention: You can call on your deity to intervene once per long rest. Effect depends on deity.
Divine Intervention Improvement: Your Divine Intervention can be used more frequently.
Divine Sense: As an action, you can detect celestial, fiend, or undead. Can be used proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Divine Smite: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal extra radiant damage.
Druid Circle Feature: Your Druid Circle grants additional features based on your circle.
Druidic: You know the Druidic secret language and can use it to hide messages.
Eldritch Invocations: You learn special invocations that refine your Pact Magic.
Eldritch Master: You can draw on your patron's power once per long rest to recharge all spell slots.
Elusive: Attacks against you can't gain advantage unless you're paralyzed or unconscious.
Empty Body: You become invisible and ethereal for 1 minute. Requires 3 ki points.
Evasion: When you make a Dexterity saving throw, you take half damage on a failure and none on a success.
Expertise: Choose two skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks with those skills.
Extra Attack: You can make two attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action.
Extra Attack (2): You can make three attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action.
Extra Attack (3): You can make four attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action.
Fast Movement: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.
Favored Enemy: You have advantage on Wisdom checks to track favored enemies and on Intelligence checks about them.
Feral Instinct: You have advantage on initiative rolls. If surprised, you can act normally on your first turn.
Feral Senses: You detect hidden creatures within 30 feet and are unaffected by dim light for vision.
Foe Slayer: Once per turn, you can add your Wisdom modifier to attack rolls against your favored enemy.
Font of Inspiration: You regain all used Bardic Inspiration dice after a long rest.
Font of Magic: You can use sorcery points to gain additional spell slots.
Hide in Plain Sight: You can hide without requiring concealment. Others take disadvantage on Wisdom checks to find you.
Improved Divine Smite: Your Divine Smite deals extra damage and works with any melee weapon attack.
Indomitable (one use): You can reroll a failed saving throw. Uses proficiency bonus times per long rest.
Indomitable (three uses): You can reroll failed saving throws three times per long rest.
Indomitable (two uses): You can reroll failed saving rolls twice per long rest.
Indomitable Might: While your rage is active, your strength score counts as 22 for carrying capacity.
Jack of All Trades: You can add half your proficiency bonus to any ability check not already trained.
Ki: You can spend ki points to power abilities like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, or Step of the Wind.
Ki-Empowered Strikes: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistances.
Land's Stride: You can move through nonmagical difficult terrain without penalty. Magical plants don't slow you.
Lay on Hands: Your blessing can heal allies. Pool of hp equals your cleric level * 3.
Magical Secrets: You can learn spells from any class's spell list.
Martial Archetype Feature: Your Martial Archetype grants additional features based on your archetype.
Martial Arts: When making an unarmed strike, you can use Dexterity instead of Strength. You can make a bonus attack.
Monastic Tradition Feature: Your Monastic Tradition grants additional features based on your tradition.
Mystic Arcanum (6th level): You learn one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list.
Mystic Arcanum (7th level): You learn one 7th-level spell from the warlock spell list.
Mystic Arcanum (8th level): You learn one 8th-level spell from the warlock spell list.
Mystic Arcanum (9th level): You learn one 9th-level spell from the warlock spell list.
Natural Explorer: You have advantage on checks related to exploring your favored terrain.
Otherworldly Patron Feature: Your Otherworldly Patron grants additional features based on your patron.
Pact Magic: You cast spells using Charisma and your mystic arcanum expands your options.
Path Feature: Your Primal Path grants additional features.
Perfect Self: When you roll for initiative and have fewer than 4 ki points, you regain 4 ki points.
Persistent Rage: Your rage doesn't end early if you drop to 0 hit points.
Primal Champion: Your Strength and Constitution increase by 4 (max 24). You are always considered raging.
Primeval Awareness: You can communicate with beasts and sense if aberrations, fey, or undead are nearby.
Purity of Body: You are immune to poison and disease.
Rage: While raging, you gain advantage on Strength checks/saves, bonus damage, and resistance to piercing, bludgeoning, slashing.
Ranger Archetype Feature: Your Ranger Archetype grants additional features based on your archetype.
Reckless Attack: You can choose to attack recklessly, gaining advantage on melee attacks and causing attackers to have advantage against you.
Relentless Rage: If you drop to 0 HP while raging, you can stay at 1 HP instead.
Reliable Talent: Ability checks where you add proficiency bonus can't roll below 10.
Ritual Casting: You can cast spells you know as rituals without using a spell slot.
Roguish Archetype Feature: Your Roguish Archetype grants additional features based on your archetype.
Sacred Oath Feature: Your Sacred Oath grants additional features based on your oath.
Second Wind: You can heal yourself as a bonus action. Once per short rest.
Signature Spells: You can cast two 3rd-level spells without using spell slots each long rest.
Slippery Mind: You are proficient in Wisdom saving throws.
Slow Fall: You take less damage when falling. Reduction equals 5 * your monk level.
Sneak Attack: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a target you have advantage on or that has an enemy within 5 feet.
Song of Rest (d10): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d10.
Song of Rest (d12): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d12.
Song of Rest (d6): Your soothing performance can help allies regain hit points during short rest.
Song of Rest (d8): Your Song of Rest die increases to a d8.
Sorcerous Origin Feature: Your Sorcerous Origin grants additional features based on your origin.
Sorcerous Restoration: You can regain up to 10.5sorcery points during a short rest.
Spell Mastery: One spell of your choice can be cast at will without using a spell slot.
Spell Mastery (Greater): Another spell of your choice can be cast at will without using a spell slot.
Spell Mastery (Master): A third spell of your choice can be cast at will without using a spell slot.
Spell Mastery (Supreme): A fourth spell of your choice can be cast at will without using a spell slot.
Spellcasting: You can cast spells using Wisdom. Prepare spells each long rest from your spell list.
Stillness of Mind: You can use an action to end one condition from the frighteneffected on yourself.
Stroke of Luck: Once per long rest, you can turn a failed check, save, or attack into a natural 20.
Stunning Strike: When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 ki to stun the target until the end of your next turn.
Superior Inspiration: When you roll initiative and have no inspiration dice, you regain one.
Thieves' Cant: You know the Thieves' Cant language and can use it to exchange secret messages.
Timeless Body: You don't need food or water. You don't suffer the effects of aging.
Tongue of the Sun and Moon: You can understand all spoken languages and any creature that speaks must understand you.
Tradition Feature: Your Arcane Tradition grants additional features based on your school.
Unarmored Defense: While not wearing armor, your AC is 10 + Dexterity + Wisdom.
Unarmored Movement: Your walking speed increases. You can climb and swim without penalty.
Unarmored Movement improvement: Your Unarmored Movement speed increases further.
Uncanny Dodge: When an attacker hits you, you can use your reaction to halve the damage.
Vanish: You can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Creatures can't track you with nonmagical means.
Wild Shape: You can transform into a beast a number of times equal to half your level.
Wild Shape Improvement: Your Wild Shape improves. You can transform into more powerful beasts.
